rows.ja: 広告枠の供給元(Googleは競合でもある)

relations.text: Googleは、The Trade Deskにとって最大の広告枠供給元の1社であり、競合でもある
relations.text_en: Google is one of The Trade Desk's largest advertising inventory suppliers and also one of its competitors.

source.label: The Trade Desk 10-K
source.quote: For example, Google is one of our largest advertising inventory suppliers in addition to being one of our competitors.

relations.text: 同じ年次報告が、Googleを競合の1社でもあるとしている
relations.text_en: The same report says Google is also one of its competitors

source.label: The Trade Desk 10-K
source.quote: For example, Google is one of our largest advertising inventory suppliers in addition to being one of our competitors.

relations.text: The Trade DeskはDSP事業で、GoogleやAmazonといった大手企業の部門と競合する
relations.text_en: The Trade Desk competes as a demand-side platform provider with divisions of large companies such as Google and Amazon.

source.label: The Trade Desk 10-K
source.quote: We compete with other demand-side platform providers, some of which are smaller, privately held companies and others are divisions of large, well-established companies such as Google and Amazon.

relations.text: JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A.が代理人を務める銀行団と、2021年6月15日付で貸付・担保契約を結んでいる
relations.text_en: The company and a syndicate of banks led by JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. as agent entered into a Loan and Security Agreement on June 15, 2021

source.label: The Trade Desk 10-K
source.quote: On June 15, 2021, we and a syndicate of banks, led by JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., as agent, entered into a Loan and Security Agreement (the “Credit Facility”).
source.note: 資金調達のみの関係です。

relations.text: JPMorgan Chase主導の銀行団と2021年6月15日付の貸付・担保契約(Credit Facility)を結んだ
relations.text_en: The Trade Desk and a bank syndicate led by JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. as agent entered into the June 15, 2021 Loan and Security Agreement (the Credit Facility)

source.label: The Trade Desk 10-K
source.quote: On June 15, 2021, the Company and a syndicate of banks, led by JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., as agent, entered into a Loan and Security Agreement (the “Credit Facility”).

relations.text: Spotify Ad Exchangeは、Sellers and Publishers 500+、オープンエクスチェンジ、プライベートマーケットプレイス取引を通じて広告主が利用できる
relations.text_en: Spotify Ad Exchange is accessible to advertisers through Sellers and Publishers 500+, open exchange, and private marketplace deals

source.label: The Trade Desk — Spotify publisher integration, September 29, 2025
source.label_en: The Trade Desk — Spotify publisher integration, September 29, 2025
source.quote: This scale is now available through the Spotify Ad Exchange, which advertisers can access through the Sellers and Publishers 500+ , open exchange, and private marketplace deals, making it easier than ever to work toward:

relations.text_en: Spotify integrated with EUID across Europe

source.label: The Trade Desk 8-K Ex.99.1 earnings release
source.label_en: The Trade Desk 8-K Ex.99.1 earnings release
source.quote: Spotify integrated with EUID across Europe.

relations.text: Netflixが「Sellers and Publishers 500+」に加わり、広告主が同社の配信枠に自動でアクセスできるようになった
relations.text_en: Netflix joined the Sellers and Publishers 500+, giving advertisers automatic access to its streaming inventory

source.label: The Trade Desk 8-K Ex.99.1 earnings release
source.label_en: The Trade Desk 8-K Ex.99.1 earnings release
source.quote: Netflix joined The Trade Desk’s Sellers and Publishers 500+, enabling advertiser access to Netflix’s premier streaming environment automatically through the company’s scaled inventory marketplace.

companies.name: パラマウント・スカイダンス

relations.text: Paramountが、主要スポーツイベントの一部広告枠でライブのプログラマティック購入をThe Trade Desk経由で提供すると発表した
relations.text_en: Paramount announced live, in-game programmatic buying for select ad units in marquee sporting events via The Trade Desk

source.label: The Trade Desk 8-K Ex.99.1 earnings release
source.label_en: The Trade Desk 8-K Ex.99.1 earnings release
source.quote: Paramount announced live, in-game programmatic buying for select commercial ad units within marquee sporting events via The Trade Desk.

relations.text: Samsung Adsがホーム画面の広告枠をプログラマティック購入者に開放し、The Trade Deskが最初に利用できるプラットフォームに含まれた
relations.text_en: Samsung Ads opened its home screen inventory to programmatic buyers, with The Trade Desk among the first platforms granted access

source.label: The Trade Desk 8-K Ex.99.1 earnings release
source.label_en: The Trade Desk 8-K Ex.99.1 earnings release
source.quote: Samsung Ads opened its premium home screen inventory to programmatic buyers, with The Trade Desk named among the first platforms granted access, giving advertisers a unified view of creative and measurement performance.
source.note: 広告部門(Samsung Ads)に関する記載です。
source.note_en: Refers to the Samsung Ads unit.

relations.text: MagniteなどのSSPがEUID(欧州向け統一ID)に対応した
relations.text_en: Magnite, among other supply-side platforms, integrated European Unified ID (EUID)

source.label: The Trade Desk 8-K Ex.99.1 earnings release
source.label_en: The Trade Desk 8-K Ex.99.1 earnings release
source.quote: Leading supply-side platforms, including FreeWheel, Index Exchange, Magnite, and PubMatic have integrated European Unified ID (EUID) to enhance addressability across the open internet.

relations.text: PubMaticなどのSSPがEUID(欧州向け統一ID)に対応した
relations.text_en: PubMatic, among other supply-side platforms, integrated European Unified ID (EUID)

source.label: The Trade Desk 8-K Ex.99.1 earnings release
source.label_en: The Trade Desk 8-K Ex.99.1 earnings release
source.quote: Leading supply-side platforms, including FreeWheel, Index Exchange, Magnite, and PubMatic have integrated European Unified ID (EUID) to enhance addressability across the open internet.

companies.name: アドビ
companies.sub: クリエイティブ・マーケティングソフト

relations.text: AdobeとThe Trade Deskが、広告の接触データをAdobe Real-Time CDPの顧客プロファイルにつなぐ新しい連携を発表した
relations.text_en: Adobe and The Trade Desk forged a new integration connecting paid media exposure data to first-party profiles in Adobe Real-Time CDP

source.label: The Trade Desk 8-K Ex.99.1 earnings release
source.label_en: The Trade Desk 8-K Ex.99.1 earnings release
source.quote: Adobe and The Trade Desk forged a new integration connecting paid media exposure data directly to first-party profiles in Adobe Real-Time CDP.

companies.name: ウーバー・テクノロジーズ

relations.text: Uberは、The Trade Deskが連携を広げた旅行・宿泊・移動分野の企業の1社
relations.text_en: The Trade Desk expanded its commerce media ecosystem through integrations with travel, hospitality and mobility companies including Uber.

source.label: The Trade Desk 8-K Ex.99.1 earnings release
source.label_en: The Trade Desk 8-K Ex.99.1 earnings release
source.quote: The Trade Desk expanded its commerce media ecosystem through integrations with leading travel, hospitality and mobility including Booking.com, Agoda, Kayak, Priceline, Marriott, Uber and United Airlines, helping advertisers activate high-intent commerce and travel signals and unify campaign activation, measurement and optimization across the open internet.

relations.text: SnowflakeがEUIDに対応し、自社データの活用を高めた
relations.text_en: Snowflake integrated EUID to enrich first-party data and improve addressability

source.label: The Trade Desk 8-K Ex.99.1 earnings release
source.label_en: The Trade Desk 8-K Ex.99.1 earnings release
source.quote: Snowflake integrated EUID to enrich first-party data and improve addressability on the open internet.

relations.text: Visaが豪州・ニュージーランドで、The Trade Deskとのデータ提携を発表した
relations.text_en: Visa announced a data partnership with The Trade Desk in Australia and New Zealand

source.label: The Trade Desk 8-K Ex.99.1 earnings release
source.label_en: The Trade Desk 8-K Ex.99.1 earnings release
source.quote: Visa announced a new data partnership with The Trade Desk in Australia and New Zealand to empower marketers to optimize campaigns with greater precision and relevance through advanced targeting capabilities.

relations.text: 電通が、新しい小売データ事業で最初のDSPパートナーにThe Trade Deskを指名した
relations.text_en: Dentsu named The Trade Desk as the first DSP partner for its new retail data offering

source.label: The Trade Desk 8-K Ex.99.1 earnings release
source.label_en: The Trade Desk 8-K Ex.99.1 earnings release
source.quote: Dentsu named The Trade Desk as the first DSP partner for its new end-to-end retail data offering from New Stream Media.

relations.text: Instacartが食料品の商品情報をThe Trade Deskのプラットフォームと連携させた
relations.text_en: Instacart integrated its grocery selection with The Trade Desk platform

source.label: The Trade Desk 8-K Ex.99.1 earnings release
source.label_en: The Trade Desk 8-K Ex.99.1 earnings release
source.quote: Instacart integrated its grocery selection with The Trade Desk platform, enabling advertisers and agencies to build first-party custom audiences based on specific product criteria.
